note: Both sets capture the legend symbols and the 1.5" vent diameter correctly, but Set A pads itself with vague, poorly bound dimension claims (e.g. 'piping | length | 8 FT', 'domestic supply line | length | 30 FT') and clearly misbinds the 60'-0" HORIZONTAL layout dimension to a 'flex pipe' length. Set B binds more diameters to the actual fixtures (toilet, shower, bathroom sink, dishwasher, kitchen group) and correctly reads the Potable Water Reel Type A / 22 05 29.01 and the MS = MODULE SPLIT FITTING keynotes. Set B's main errors are the unsupported 'Toilet | vertical distance from header | 8 ft' and the dubious 'GDP connected to DISHWASHER', while Set A's title-block 'CHECKED BY: ANDREW GONG' is a genuine strength. Overall Set B is more faithful and less padded, though the margin is modest.
